text:
Anya P.: Heads up, 0.7.0 is live. We're getting a handful of customer reports. Need quick prioritization: which issues go into an immediate hotfix, which are 0.7.1, which go to backlog. Short summary: 2 customer-facing regressions, 3 medium-impact, rest are polish/enhancements.
Mike R.: Adding details in tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-1257 (repro steps + affected orgs).
Devon H.: Call out the two customer-facing regressions? Can we defer infra-internal things to 0.7.1?
Anya P.: The P0s: (1) streaming fallback sometimes drops the final message (visible in chat flows). (2) embeddings endpoint times out for long inputs for certain orgs (~500s). Both look serious.
Leah G.: Streaming drop is big UX pain 1 users lose context. Strong preference for hotfix on streaming.
Mike R.: Agree on streaming. Embeds timeout looks like an orchestration/regression; might be mitigated with a targeted guard and done in 0.7.1.
release-bot: Deploy window open today 18:00 UTC. Patch branch: refs/heads/patch/0.7.1. Runbook: https://confluence.example/release/runbooks/0.7.1
Anya P.: Proposed plan: hotfix for streaming fallback in today's window; embeddings timeout addressed in 0.7.1 with canary rollout. Minor UX polish -> backlog.
Devon H.: SRE will investigate embed timeouts. I can try a temporary throttling guard if it's a config/regression. ETA: end of day for first findings.
Mike R.: I'll build a streaming guard and add unit/integration checks. Rollout: hotfix -> canary 5% -> ramp. Embed mitigation -> 0.7.1 canary 5% 1h then full.
Anya P.: Acceptance criteria to close tickets: streaming fix must show zero dropped messages in the synthetic suite for 30m and no customer reports from canary orgs; embeds must hit 99.9% success in canary for 1h. Otherwise rollback.
Leah G.: Design note: preserve timestamp ordering on retry. Not blocking the hotfix unless it interferes with UX. Move to backlog if safe.
Mike R.: Action items: @Devon H. -> sampling/heap/flame to hunt root cause and apply mitigation. @Mike R. -> implement streaming guard + tests. @Anya P. -> notify affected customers + post status page update.
Devon H.: I'll post findings in RED-1257. If it's a config leak between services I can hotpatch a throttle to reduce timeouts.
Anya P.: Locking scope: hotfix = streaming fallback fix + status update; 0.7.1 = embed timeout fix + tests; backlog = UX polish. I'll update the release ticket and roadmap.
Mike R.: Patch branch steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/0.7.1
# cherry-pick streaming fix commit
git push origin patch/0.7.1
```
Mike R.: @Devon H. can you confirm you have access to patch branch when ready? :eyes: 
Devon H.: Confirmed. I'll push debug artifacts to patch branch if needed.
Anya P.: Thanks. If anything blocks deploy we escalate to on-call and decide rollback vs patch.
Mike R.: :white_check_mark: moving cards and assigning owners now.
release-bot: Incident draft created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2024-0009 (Anya P. to publish)
